copy.curiosityHook: Elle readily accepts the advances of an obsessed mechanic, but the real mystery is the concealed purpose driving her into his life.
copy.description: After moving to a small French village, Elle strikes up a romance with Pin-Pon, an infatuated local mechanic. But beneath the summer heat, she harbors a calculating, personal motive of her own.
copy.vibeSummary: A steady, emotionally heavy French crime drama fueled by quiet obsession and simmering suspense, best absorbed in focused solo viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Jean Becker directs a simmering, character-driven French mystery that blends small-town drama with psychological tension and an undercurrent of lingering, heavy stakes.
